key_concepts: Living things breathe, eat, grow, move, and reproduce.
Non-living things do not need to eat to remain.
Living things depend on non-living things to survive.
Non-living things can exist without depending on other things.
Living and non-living things have important roles in the environment.
Plants are living things that grow in soil or water.
Soil, water, sunlight, and air are non-living things.
Plants need nutrients, sunlight, and carbon dioxide to live and grow.
Plants reproduce through seeds, leaves, branches, and roots.
Living and non-living things are interconnected.
Actions of living things can affect other living things.
People, animals, and plants are living; tools and natural forces are non-living.
